verdict.rationale: The collection ships a dedicated writing-skills skill/module with a TDD-style methodology for authoring skills (write test cases, watch fail, write skill, watch pass, refactor) and explicit skill-authoring docs (SKILL.md, writing-skills module, testing harness for skill compliance), satisfying the meta-skill-for-skill-authoring story. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on account specifically validating the skill-authoring workflow (community evidence discusses brainstorming/planning but not the meta-skill for writing new skills), and no example of packaging/distributing a newly authored skill end-to-end.
